title: Grounded and Faithful P&ID Reasoning: Constraining Vision-Language Models with Recovered Evidence Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2609.05880v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) are the authoritative maps of process plants: isolation, maintenance, and HAZOP decisions depend on what connects to what. Vision-language models describe these sheets fluently, yet they often invent or miss process connections---and an invented or missed link can reverse an isolation or reachability call, so a plant decision cannot trust a fluent answer that was never checked against the linework. We instead recover an explicit graph of the drawing---its symbols, the process connections between them, and the tags that name them---and then require the model to answer only by querying that graph through seven read-only operators, so a topology claim is returned only when it cites the query results that support it. On TopoPID-VQA, a new suite of 3000 topology questions over these sheets, Graph-Grounded Harness (Ours) raises exact match accuracy from 36.7--41.3% under image-only prompting to 74.

translated_title: 有依据且忠实的管道与仪表图推理：利用恢复的证据图约束视觉语言模型
translated_abstract: 管道与仪表图（P&ID）是过程工厂的权威地图：隔离、维护和HAZOP决策都依赖于“什么连接到什么”。视觉语言模型能够流畅地描述这些图纸，但它们经常虚构或遗漏工艺连接——而一个被虚构或遗漏的连接可能颠覆隔离或可达性判断，因此工厂决策不能信任从未对照图纸线条核查过的流畅回答。我们转而恢复图纸的显式图结构——包括其符号、符号之间的工艺连接以及命名它们的标签——然后要求模型仅通过七个只读算子查询该图来作答，从而保证只有当拓扑断言引用了支持它的查询结果时才会被返回。在TopoPID-VQA（一个针对这些图纸、包含3000个拓扑问题的新测试集）上，图接地框架（Graph-Grounded Harness，本文方法）将精确匹配准确率从仅图像提示下的36.7–41.3%提升到74%（原文截断于此）。
tldr: 本文提出从P&ID图纸中恢复显式证据图，并约束视觉语言模型仅通过七个只读算子查询该图作答、使拓扑结论必须引用支持的查询结果，从而将TopoPID-VQA上的精确匹配准确率从约36.7–41.3%大幅提升至约74%。
en_tdlr: This paper recovers an explicit evidence graph from P&ID drawings and constrains vision-language models to answer only through seven read-only graph queries, ensuring every topology claim cites supporting query results and boosting exact-match accuracy on TopoPID-VQA from ~36.7–41.3% to ~74%.
